verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's SRE Agent and Insights Agent perform some proactive investigative work — deducing next steps by analyzing GitHub code and Sentry logs, surfacing recommended rules from historical events/incidents, and delivering proactive recommendations from analytics — which aligns with autonomous correlation of changes/telemetry before human involvement. However, there's no direct documented evidence of a unified 'AI investigator' that explicitly correlates code changes, live telemetry, AND similar past incidents together into a single probable-cause narrative proactively, ahead of human request. missing for 10: explicit evidence of cross-source correlation (code changes + telemetry + historical incident similarity) combined into one probable-cause report, independent/hands-on validation of this proactive investigation actually happening unprompted, and confirmation of accuracy/reliability from real users.
